Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi is seeking a highly motivated Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst to join the Collateral Management Engines Technology team within Markets Technology.

jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
The Apple Card & Savings team is building the financial products that put users in control of their money. We built Apple Card to reinvent how credit cards work, and we continue to launch groundbreaking features used by millions of people every day. We are looking for a technical lead who craves the challenge of architecting mission-critical systems at scale, sets technical direction across teams, and is equally at home in a design review, a production incident, or a technical negotiation with a financial partner.
  
  
Description
  
  
You'll lead the architecture and evolution of the distributed services that power Apple Card and Savings, while staying hands-on in code and operations. You'll be given the flexibility to drive creative solutions, the support of a talented and driven team, and the autonomy and responsibility to take full ownership of critical systems. Our team operates as DevOps: we build what we run. You'll shape the architecture of our platform through deep experience operating, monitoring, and supporting it on call, and you'll set the bar for how we ship and run software — safe, progressive releases, clear service level objectives, and automation over manual toil. You'll lead large, multi-quarter efforts — including complex integrations with financial institution and payment network partners and other Apple services — from conception through production, with reliability and customer trust as non-negotiables. As a technical leader, you'll drive technical discussions across teams and organizations, write specifications, represent Apple in technical discussions with external partners, review code and designs, mentor senior engineers, and raise the engineering bar for the team. Success in this role requires strong self-motivation, crisp and clear communication, a highly collaborative approach, and the ability to define and influence engineering strategy well beyond your own team.

**Job Description**
-------------------

This is a remote position.

We are seeking a Database Developer with approximately four years of professional experience to support database development, modernization, cloud-hosted PostgreSQL environments, and migration initiatives.

The ideal candidate has strong SQL and database development skills and hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and Oracle, familiarity with the AWS Database Migration, and practical experience using Liquibase to manage database changes through DevSecOps pipelines. The candidate should be comfortable developing automation scripts and collaborating with microservice teams to ensure database structures remain aligned with application object models.

* **Database Development and Schema Management**
* + Maintain and optimize a PostgreSQL database hosted in AWS.

  + Work with senior developers to execute the migration of existing data and schema from an Oracle database to PostgreSQL, ensuring data integrity and performance.
  + Maintain technical documentation for database design, configuration, schema changes, and operational procedures.
  + Monitor and tune database performance for reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
  + Design and implement back-up and disaster recovery processes to ensure high availability and business continuity.
  + Manage database backups, restores, and updates in alignment with best practices.
